# Artiflex IT

> Artiflex IT is a UAE-based IT solutions and managed services provider. We deliver cybersecurity, cloud, IT infrastructure, business software, application security, and fully managed IT services for organisations across the Emirates, with vendor-neutral advice and 24/7 support.

This file helps AI systems and answer engines understand Artiflex IT's offerings and locate the most relevant pages. All links use canonical URLs.

## Core Services

- [Cybersecurity](https://artiflexit.com/cybersecurity): Layered defense from perimeter firewalls to endpoint detection, backed by a 24/7 security operations center.
- [Cloud Solutions](https://artiflexit.com/cloud-solutions): Design, migration, and management of public, private, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
- [IT Infrastructure](https://artiflexit.com/infrastructure): Networks, structured cabling, servers, storage, and physical security built to scale without bottlenecks.
- [Managed Services](https://artiflexit.com/managed-services): Proactive monitoring, patch management, and help desk support under a predictable monthly fee.
- [Application Security](https://artiflexit.com/application-security-solutions): Penetration testing, secure code review, WAF management, and DAST scanning aligned with OWASP Top 10.
- [Business Solutions](https://artiflexit.com/business-solutions): Implementation and integration of ERP, CRM, finance, and HR platforms with vendor-neutral, TCO-grounded advice.

## Cybersecurity Solutions

- [Firewalls and Network Security](https://artiflexit.com/cybersecurity/firewalls-network-security): Next-generation firewall selection, deployment, and management.
- [Endpoint Security (EDR / XDR)](https://artiflexit.com/cybersecurity/endpoint-security-edr-xdr): Endpoint detection and response across leading platforms.
- [Email Security](https://artiflexit.com/cybersecurity/email-security): Anti-phishing, anti-malware, and email threat protection.
- [Data Loss Prevention (DLP)](https://artiflexit.com/cybersecurity/data-loss-prevention): Protecting sensitive data across endpoints, network, and cloud.
- [Identity and Access Security](https://artiflexit.com/cybersecurity/identity-access-security): IAM, IGA, MFA, and PAM strategy and tooling.
- [Mobile Security](https://artiflexit.com/cybersecurity/mobile-security): Unified endpoint management and mobile threat defense.
- [OT / ICS Security](https://artiflexit.com/cybersecurity/ot-ics-security): Operational technology and industrial control system protection.
- [Security Operations (SIEM / MDR / NDR)](https://artiflexit.com/cybersecurity/security-operations): Managed detection, response, and security monitoring.
- [Vulnerability Management](https://artiflexit.com/cybersecurity/vulnerability-management): Continuous scanning, prioritisation, and remediation advisory.
- [Workspace Protection (SSE / SASE / CASB)](https://artiflexit.com/cybersecurity/workspace-protection-sse-sase): Zero Trust access, secure web gateway, and cloud app security.
- [Unified Firewall Management](https://artiflexit.com/cybersecurity/unified-firewall-management): Centralised policy and management across firewall estates.

- [Public Cloud](https://artiflexit.com/cloud-solutions/public-cloud): AWS, Azure, and GCP design and management.
- [Private Cloud](https://artiflexit.com/cloud-solutions/private-cloud): Dedicated, single-tenant cloud environments.
- [Hybrid Cloud](https://artiflexit.com/cloud-solutions/hybrid-cloud): Integrated on-premises and cloud operations.
- [Multi-Cloud Strategy](https://artiflexit.com/cloud-solutions/multi-cloud-strategy): Workload placement across multiple providers.

- [Disaster Recovery](https://artiflexit.com/cloud-solutions/disaster-recovery-solutions-dubai): Business continuity and disaster recovery in Dubai and the UAE.
